answers.core:
the people who would need this feature the most are beginners, who would not think of looking for such a plug-in
as they don't realize they're even making a mistake when saving their scenes with a filename in PascalCase instead of snake_case.
answers.workaround:
It might be possible to implement this behaviour into the engine with your own plug-in,
but i'm not sure.

title: Reformat the Root Node's name into snake_case before suggesting it as the filename when saving a new scene
